description: AzCrash bell ratios: max over the bell captures vs max over the upper half of the bow captures, each normalised to its capture; normalised to the 95th percentile, clipped to 1; then calibrated by rendering (2026-11-22): per range, the ratios of the modes the bell strikes (exc > 0) scaled until the plugin's bell matched BellSoft, not clipped (34 above 1); modes with exc 0 keep the built value
